snippet.title: Fortnite Festival - Official LISA Season 12 Icon Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the LISA Season 12 Icon Trailer for Fortnite Festival, the rhythmic action music game within Fortnite developed by Harmonix and Epic Games. Players can enjoy specific songs and content from the global superstar LISA, who's the next Fortnite Festival Icon. LISA takes the Fortnite Festival stage on November 29.
